audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: The WSG temperature-chain fold, the first seam round after gap closure: no new book pages. Every pinned value is a landed original re-read from its header and pinned again on the fold side, so each identity compiles and rides the mutant battery. The chain: one wilderness temperature feeds the dress Table 3 column dispatch (rules/wsgdress.h wsdColForTemp, boundaries below 0, 0-30, 31-75, 76 plus), the Table 9 damage band dispatch (rules/wsgheat.h wshHeatBandFor, 25 bands, no-damage band 16 at 31-84, frostbite threshold 0), the weather letter codes (rules/wsgweather.h wwsTempCodeHi, D tops at 0, H at 30) and the R498 survival shifts (plus 20 at 30 or lower, minus 20 at 80 or higher). Three boundary alignments are true (31 with 31, 30 with 30, 0 with 0); one is a deliberate non-alignment (the hot column opens at 76, eight degrees inside the no-damage band - attire adjusts before damage resumes at 85); the protected no-damage span is wider on both ends (6 through 89).

banner.provenance: No new book pages: every value is the landed original re-read from its header (wsdColForTemp, wshHeatBandFor, wshFrostbiteTempMax, wshT9DashUnprotCensus, wwsTempCodeHi, wpdSurvColdEffShift and kin) and re-pinned on the fold side so the boundary identities compile and ride the mutant battery. The findings: the three true alignments (the moderate column and band 16 open at the same 31; band 15 and the cold column top at the same 30; the frostbite threshold equals the below-0 boundary value), the deliberate non-alignment (the hot column opens at 76 inside the 31-84 no-damage band), the finer dress grid (moderate tops at 75, no-damage runs to 84) and the protected widening (6 through 89).
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: census 423 -> 424; the gap report stays 186 closed / 0 open (closed - no flips this round); the chain has no gaps.
banner.title: The WSG TEMPERATURE-CHAIN FOLD, R499: the first seam round after the gap report closed at 186/0. The dressing columns (rules/wsgdress.h), the heat bands and the frostbite threshold (rules/wsgheat.h), the weather letter codes (rules/wsgweather.h) and the survival shifts (rules/wsgprofd.h) reconciled as one system: every wilderness temperature flows from one generated number through exactly one dress column and exactly one heat band.

bools.comment: band 15 tops at the same 30 that tops the cold column - the second true alignment.
bools.name: wtfBand15TopsWithColdCol
